stepNotes.1: TaskQueueRoutes is mounted at /task-queue (server.ts:307) and defines eleven documented operations from list/enqueue through delete (task-queue.ts:42-280).
stepNotes.2: The boundary accepts durable executable payloads and lifecycle mutations; schema validation, loopback-only listening, optional auth, origin enforcement, and project Instance setup precede handlers (validation.ts:4-12; server.ts:166-195,258-277).
stepNotes.3: IDs, query filters, bodies, numeric coercions, session compatibility, project ownership, and ordinary action states are validated before non-racing mutations (task-queue.ts:13-38,60-63,83-86; session/task-queue.ts:177-183,288-375,472-499).
stepNotes.4: MEDIUM: send-now reads then later forces queued before calling start, so a concurrent atomic claim can be overwritten and the detached work claimed a second time; pause has a similar stale-check transition (session/task-queue.ts:406-475,677-701).
stepNotes.5: List is capped at 500 and backed by project-position/status/session indexes, while reorder and send-now touch O(q) project rows; this is a retained-queue scaling caveat rather than a separate finding (session.sql.ts:132-165).
stepNotes.6: MEDIUM: the lifecycle status route relies on a fixed header but OpenAPI and the generated SDK publish the exact value, allowing ordinary clients to bypass action preconditions and assign any TaskQueue.Status (task-queue.ts:27-31,112-136; sdk.gen.ts:1452-1485).
stepNotes.7: LOW: multiple routes omit reachable 409 responses even though session/project checks and assertActionStatus throw 409; edit is the lone action whose response map already includes it (task-queue.ts:145-150; session/task-queue.ts:177-183,232-237,723-727).
stepNotes.8: Focused route tests passed 8/8 and core typecheck passed; direct GET, pause/resume/cancel, cross-project errors, OpenAPI completeness, and send-now/claim concurrency remain uncovered (task-queue-routes.test.ts:14-550).
stepNotes.9: The review records two MEDIUM correctness/design defects and two LOW contract/coverage gaps, with no Critical or High item; the empty findings directory therefore does not trigger a reverify.md file.
